candidates.statement: Inventory service is rejecting a configuration value after a recent deployment (cfg-015, configuration_valid=false, change_age 3 min), producing 9 configuration_value_rejected errors with status 503 and 14 configuration rejections, degrading checkout health.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not prove causation; gateway/order/payment remain healthy, so blast radius to checkout is inferred from inventory 503s.

report.explanation: Inventory shows configuration_value_rejected errors (9, status 503) and 14 configuration rejections coinciding with a 3-minute-old deployment whose configuration_valid=false (cfg-015). Other services show healthy logs/metrics. This supports a bad-configuration root cause in inventory; deployment record alone does not establish causation.
